pose: Natural, athletic upright posture. The Allosaurus stands tall on its powerful hind legs with its torso slightly more vertical to fit the tall frame. The neck maintains its natural, powerful S-curve—not elongated or stretched. The head is positioned near the top edge, and the full body length from head to tail-tip (diagonally) fills the vertical 1024px span. Friendly, alert expression.

environmental_details.ground: Pale, dusty tan earth with scattered white caliche nodules to maximize light bounce.
environmental_details.flora: Sparse, low-lying Fern Prairies in the background, keeping the mid-ground open and sun-drenched.
environmental_details.sky: Clear, vibrant blue sky with high-key midday sunlight.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Direct sun with warm highlights on leathery skin textures and soft-edged cinematic shadows.
